pregnancy.quote: Risk Summary Based on findings from animal studies and its mechanism of action, ALIMTA can cause fetal harm when administered to a pregnant woman [see Clinical Pharmacology ( 12.1 )] .

lactation.quote: Because of the potential for serious adverse reactions in breastfed infants from ALIMTA, advise women not to breastfeed during treatment with ALIMTA and for one week after the last dose.

reproductive.quote: Contraception Females Because of the potential for genotoxicity, advise females of reproductive potential to use effective contraception during treatment with ALIMTA and for 6 months after the last dose.
